scope: non-learning present-position fly interface check; no game judgement, score, DAN or plasticity

engineering_assumptions.EA-01: reuse frozen 32-KC Gaussian present-position encoder, sigma 0.08, peak drive 1.2 mV-equivalent
engineering_assumptions.EA-02: reuse fixed inverse MBON05 0.05-position-bin readout, 0.005572335995331903 mV-equivalent threshold, 10 ms hold
engineering_assumptions.EA-03: reuse contact-ratio normalized KC-to-MBON05 weights and 2 ms synaptic delay as bounded electrical overlay
engineering_assumptions.EA-04: reuse 1 ms LIF integration and frozen membrane parameters from source config
engineering_assumptions.EA-07: reuse 32 audited source-order KCs and MBON05 reduced MaleCNS subset

primary_gate: initial_weights has no DOWN and at least two of three local arms have one first DOWN within 0.10 normalized position of their own probe center; exact repeated traces
failure_rule: stop and report FAIL if primary_gate does not pass; no gain, threshold, cohort or center adjustment
